title: Sovereign Grace
description: In this sermon, the speaker emphasizes the importance of understanding the biblical explanation for one's conversion experience. He refers to Ephesians 1:4, which states that our transition from death to life, from sinner to saved, is solely the result of God's sovereign grace. The speaker shares a personal story of his own conversion experience at the age of five, where he felt a deep sense of sinfulness and prayed for God's presence. He concludes by highlighting the profound impact of God's pursuit and love for us, even when we may not be actively seeking Him.
